source.title: Ulster Herald, 23 May 1964, p. 11 ("Only one change in Strabane Rural")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of Strabane Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There were no contests: the political representation remained 20 Unionists and 8 Nationalists, with three members to be co-opted at the first meeting. The only change in personnel was in Leckpatrick, where Mr. John R. Boak (U.) replaced Mr. James K. Stevenson (U.), who retired for business reasons. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
